prompt: What were the circumstances when consent was given? Select all that apply.

options.label: Several officers were present, or weapons were drawn
An officer said they had a warrant or could search anyway
An officer said they would get a warrant, or implied other consequences, if your client refused
Your client was under arrest or otherwise detained when asked
Your client wasn't told they could refuse
Your client gave in to repeated requests (e.g. after first refusing)
Your client was intoxicated, injured, or had difficulty understanding (e.g. language, age, mental condition)
The officer asked with a phrase like “do you mind if…”

prompt: During the consent search, did any of these happen? Select all that apply; leave blank if none.

options.label: Police searched somewhere other than what they asked to search (e.g. asked about the car's center console and searched the trunk)
Your client limited the consent (e.g. “just the trunk”), and police searched beyond that limit
Police opened a locked or sealed container
Police damaged or took apart property
Your client objected or withdrew consent, and police kept going

_author_notes: Replaced q_consent_scope_problems on 2026-10-12 (facts in, issues out): the old prompt asked whether the search 'went beyond what your client agreed to'. Options drafted by Claude and revised by the maintainer (the limit option names both the limit and the search past it; the first option's example).
